name: Maestro

rounds.endCondition: Final Scoring after the 4th Exhibition phase

categories.label: VP on track after round 4 Exhibition
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track sau Exhibition vòng 4
categories.hint: Workshop's VP accumulated during play (Galleries, Publicity, Study etc.). One entry per Workshop (a team of 2 shares one Workshop).

categories.label: Removed Sistine Chapel tiles
categories.hint: Michelangelo only: 2 VP per removed tile.

categories.label: Empty Workshop rows
categories.hint: Michelangelo only: 2 VP per empty row.

categories.label: VP of built Inventions
categories.labelVi: VP các Invention đã chế tạo
categories.hint: Da Vinci only: sum VP printed next to emptied spaces on Blueprint cards.

categories.label: Patroness card VP
categories.hint: Sum the scoring of all Patroness cards collected (per-card conditions in appendix; values are component-driven).

categories.label: Study track progress (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Higher space is better; if on same space, the marker on the bottom wins.

tiebreakers.description: Further along the Study track; if same space, the marker at the bottom.

notes: family: sum-of-categories (running VP track + workshop board + Patroness). Two Workshops compete; each is one player or a team of two. Event module, Benefactor and solo rules not modelled. Patroness values depend on card conditions, so scorer enters total.

sources.title: Maestro rulebook (Board&Dice)
sources.section: p.17 Final Scoring and Tie Breaker; pp.20-21 Patroness appendix
